newsitem.title: FRANCE: BASKETBALL-PAU EXTEND UNBEATEN RUN AT HOME TO 11 MONTHS.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-PAU EXTEND UNBEATEN RUN AT HOME TO 11 MONTHS.

text.p: Pau-Orthez extended their 11-month unbeaten home run when they narrowly beat pace-setting Virtus Bologna 89-83 in a nailbitting EuroLeague basketball match on Thursday.

Pau, whose last loss at home was against European champions Panathinaikos in November, owed much to their skilful playmaker Antoine Rigaudeau who shared the best scorer spot with the visitors' Zoran Savic on 25 points.
Relying on a strong individual defence, Pau stretched their lead to 19 points by the 23rd minute, but Savic hit a good scoring rhythm to narrow the gap to 58-54 with 10 minutes to go.
Pau reacted well with Thierry Gadou, who ended with 21 points, ensuring the Italians stayed at least three points behind until the final whistle.

With three wins from five matches and a home game to come next against bottom-of-the-table Dynamo Moscow, the French can look forward to progressing to the next stage. Bologna have also won three of their first five games.
